title: Above-ground tanks.
officialText:
Above-ground tanks in areas of special flood hazard shall be:
1. Elevated to or above the design flood elevation specified in ASCE 24, Table 7-1; or
2. Designed, constructed, installed, and anchored to prevent flotation, collapse and lateral movement resulting from hydrodynamic and hydrostatic loads, including the effects of buoyancy, during conditions of flooding to the design flood elevation, in accordance with ASCE 24.
